To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the environmental innovation activity of firms is positively affected by the following determinants: the environmental awareness of the company's management; the existence of environmental management systems; the existence of a separate environmental budget; the existence of an environmental department; the number of employees; the size of the firm; the existence of research and development; the existence of product innovation; the existence of process innovation; the existence in a high technology industry; the existence in the service industry; and the existence of an international orientation.

(1) environmental innovation is positively influenced by environmental policy instruments, (2) environmental innovation is negatively influenced by the level of environmental protection standards, (3) environmental innovation is not influenced by the level at which environmental policy instruments are implemented, (4) environmental innovation is more likely to occur in companies with a higher degree of environmental awareness, and (5) the level of environmental innovation is higher for large companies than for small and medium-sized enterprises.

- the environmental innovation behaviour is influenced by the same factors as non-environmental innovations, - environmental innovation behaviour is more strongly influenced by environmental policy instruments, - the impact of environmental policy is stronger in the case of large companies, - the impact is stronger for companies in the manufacturing sector, - the impact on the innovation behaviour is stronger in the chemical industry, - the impact varies by the type of environmental policy instrument.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: Which determinants influence the innovative behaviour of companies?
the question whether environmental policy instruments have an impact on the innovation behaviour in the environmental sector.
the following questions: What is the general structure of the environmental innovation behaviour in Germany?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the environmental policy instruments are not a sufficient condition for the promotion of environmental innovation.
the environmental policy instruments have a positive influence on the environmental innovation behaviour.
there is no evidence of a significant impact of environmental policy measures on innovative behaviour of companies, at least not in Germany.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the impact of the policy instruments on the behaviour of companies is not very strong, but that it is still significant.
the environmental innovation behaviour is mainly determined by the company’s own characteristics and by the characteristics of the product market.
the impact of environmental policy is not very significant.
The main takeaway from our work is that
environmental policy is not the most important driver of environmental innovation.
environmental policy instruments have an influence on the environmental innovation behaviour.
environmental innovation behaviour is influenced by a number of factors.
